description: Fork of exp475 (1.4962). SINGLE change: backward_mode='soft'→'prob'. Probabilistic forward: instead of argmax, each (batch, table) samples one row from softmax(ts/T_sel). Forward selects a single row (same inference bandwidth as soft/ste). Weight gradient: index_add at sampled row (STE-style). Input gradient: gradient of E[output] through full softmax distribution — does NOT depend on which row was sampled. Hypothesis: at bs=16 the argmax always hits the top row, starving cold rows; probabilistic selection gives all rows non-zero probability, increasing gradient coverage.
